forecast_policy.rule: Formal PE valuation uses current-year consensus EPS as the primary low-risk earnings anchor. Next-year EPS is a durability check: positive next-year growth cannot automatically raise the current-year low-risk entry price, while weak/negative next-year growth may lower the permitted PE floor. H1 EPS times two is diagnostic fallback only and cannot by itself create a formal value anchor.

low_risk_pe_policy.rule: Business multiple_range is a theoretical fair-value reference, not automatically a low-risk entry multiple. Unless a company has an explicit low_risk_multiple_range, cap the theoretical PE floor by next-year earnings durability. Positive future growth does not lift the current-year entry PE; weak or negative future growth can compress it. The derived low-risk upper multiple is capped near the adjusted floor plus a small width and never exceeds the theoretical business upper multiple.
